summary: T0-03 meets all four acceptance criteria on evidence I saw. make schema-check, make check and make test all exit 0 (404 tests pass). Only story-listed files changed: Makefile, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, schema.py, tests, schemas and cases. I found no blocker or high issues. I did not run `make schema`, because it writes files.

checks.criterion: make schema writes the three schema files as 2020-12 JSON Schema, deterministically
checks.evidence: Makefile `schema` target runs `schema write packages/schema/json`. schema.py:152-196 sets the 2020-12 dialect, uses fixed indentation and a trailing newline, and defines Validation as list[GateRecord]. The three committed files exist in packages/schema/json. The test at test_json_schema.py:224 checks determinism across processes. I did not run `make schema` itself (it writes files); `make schema-check` regenerates in a temporary directory and reported a match.

checks.criterion: make schema-check regenerates into a temp dir and exits non-zero, printing the diff, when the committed files differ
checks.evidence: Output: 'JSON Schemas match schema.py: packages/schema/json'. schema.py:218-251 builds a unified diff and main returns 1 on any difference. Tests at test_json_schema.py:254-325 cover an extra field, a differing file, and missing, extra or irregular files.

checks.criterion: cases.json lists {name, schema, valid, value} cases covering the required minimum
checks.evidence: The file has 54 cases. It includes manifest-real-shaped, manifest-mock, manifest-missing-mock, manifest-unknown-field, bad sha256 variants, gate-bad-status, gate-missing-status and gate-result-null (valid), plus Validation cases.

checks.criterion: Tests check every case against pydantic and the generated JSON Schema (jsonschema dev-only), validate the mock bundle's manifest.json and validation.json, and show an extra-field model drifts
checks.evidence: 404 passed. test_json_schema.py:447 (pydantic verdict), :452 (JSON Schema verdict), :456 (mock bundle files) and :254 (extra field drift) exist and ran. jsonschema is added only to the root dev dependency group in pyproject.toml. The tests use a custom oracle that fixes the trailing-newline `$` matching in stock jsonschema, and the tests document why.
ruff check passed, ruff format --check reported 7 files already formatted, mypy found no issues.

findings.claim: Existing test_schema.py was modified, which is not a pattern in the story's file list (pipeline/tests/* does cover it).
findings.evidence: It adds 2**53 to the rejected byte counts. This tightens the test rather than weakening it. Informational only.
